blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — A 15-year-old Grade 11 student was wounded after being stabbed by a fellow student at a school in Laoag City in nearby Ilocos Norte on Friday (Oct. 2). The Laoag City Police Station, in a report, said the incident stemmed from a confrontation between the two students at Balatong Integrated School. The situation reportedly intensified into a verbal altercation before one was stabbed. A teacher intervened and stopped the clash. The wounded minor was brought to a medical facility for treatment.
